lines: Again? Ash on the blade… you touched the flame, didn't you? Never mind. I raise steel, not lives.
Good, the iron's still there. Don't make me bury the same iron twice.
Old debt's paid. The fire burns… a little steadier than before.
Upgrading still costs gold. Sentiment doesn't burn as coal.
That break… you picked it up in the training yard? Give it here.
The broken sword's near the weapon rack in the training yard. Don't tell me you got lost.
Meager Edge. Ugly name, works fine. Bring gold if you want it upgraded.
…If you've a moment, go take a look at the training yard for me. Old debt.
The door's not open so rabbits can sightsee.
